column1:
Showers may occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from Chilaw to Matara
via Colombo and Galle.

Winds will be westerly to south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and Puttalam, and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
Wind speed can increase up to (45-50) kmph at times in the other sea areas around the island.

The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and Puttalam, and
from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The naval and fishing communities
who are engaged in fishing and naval activities in the above sea areas are requested to be vigilant
in this regard.
The other sea areas around the island may be fairly rough at times.
